description: This file contains the PHP class 'Voucher' for the checkout process in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles voucher-related functionalities such as displaying the voucher form, adding, removing, and processing voucher data, as well as showing success messages after voucher application.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class managing voucher functionalities in the checkout process of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the voucher entry page, including breadcrumbs, voucher information, voucher themes, and layout components.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new voucher, validates input data, saves voucher info in session, and returns JSON response for AJAX calls.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the session and provides appropriate JSON response, handling errors and redirections.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays the success page after a voucher has been successfully applied.
